BiblicalUsage: Meker is merchandise, the ware that is bought and sold, and the price it fetches. Nehemiah 13:16 finds men of Tyre selling fish and all manner of ware in Jerusalem on the sabbath, and Numbers 20:19 has Israel offer to pay for any water they drink on the way through Edom.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that honest trade is no sin, but selling on the sabbath showed where Tyre's merchants and Judah's buyers had put their hearts.
